mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have a temperature of 62 degrees with moderate rain falling near Harriet Park under a waxing crescent moon.
The City of Verona is encouraging residents to sign up for their digital newsletter. It is the best way to stay informed about city projects, programs, and important news updates.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness or catch Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, enjoy live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a notable incident from September 5, police responded to reports of cheese being placed on various vehicle windshields as part of a social media prank, though no actual damage was caused.
Our local Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
